sentences: Most people assume the figure is screaming, but according to Munch's own notes it is the other way around.
Walking at sunset on a road above the Oslo fjord with friends, he saw the sky turn blood-red and felt an infinite scream passing through nature, and he covered his ears.
So the figure is not shouting; it is blocking out a sound.
The skull-like face, the warping sky and water, and the rigid diagonal of the railing make anxiety visible.
Munch returned to the subject several times in paintings and prints.
A faint pencil note in the sky, 'could only have been painted by a madman,' was long thought to be a visitor's graffiti, but was recently confirmed to be in Munch's own hand.
